description: Structured feature list. One active feature at a time. Evidence required before status=done.

features.title: Land portable harness core files
definition_of_done: AGENT.md, MEMORY.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, session-handoff.md, init.sh, .grok/README.md exist
PLAN.md and RAW_MATERIALS.md present in template repo

features.title: Add README explaining how to copy the harness into any repo
definition_of_done: README.md documents copy steps, required customizations, and startup contract
A new agent can follow README + AGENT.md without prior context

features.title: Optional: minimal audit / self-check script
definition_of_done: Script checks presence of core files and basic JSON validity

features.title: Run log + duration tracking for persistence analysis
definition_of_done: runs.md (or equivalent) records each agent session: start time, end time, duration, active feature, outcome
AGENT.md / session-handoff instructs agents to append a run entry before ending
Enables measuring wall-clock duration and spotting short vs long runs
features.evidence: runs.md created; AGENT.md requires logging; README documents Duration & persistence. Committed 2026-11-04.

features.title: Hard multi-session persistence test protocol
definition_of_done: docs/PERSISTENCE_TEST.md (or similar) defines a deliberately hard, multi-dialog scenario
Scenario forces at least 2–3 forced handoffs and checks whether state + next step survive
Includes success criteria and what to measure (duration per leg, resume correctness)

features.title: Strengthen session-handoff for long-running resume
definition_of_done: session-handoff.md template includes: last run duration, elapsed wall time since feature start, concrete resume checklist, known failure modes
features.evidence: session-handoff.md has Timing, Resume checklist, Known failure modes, Template fields. AGENT.md End of Session documents required fields. Committed 2026-11-04.

features.title: Version metadata + richer audit (multi-session test vehicle)
definition_of_done: VERSION file or equivalent harness version field exists and is referenced from README or AGENT.md
audit-harness.sh checks for strengthened session-handoff sections (e.g. Timing or Resume checklist)
Evidence recorded; suitable as multi-leg persistence test subject
features.notes: Vehicle for docs/PERSISTENCE_TEST.md: implement across ≥3 forced dialog boundaries; log duration each leg.
